decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 14 March 2005, the proposed erection of a single-storey outbuilding for use as a gym/store to the rear garden of existing house, measuring 8.5m wide by 5m deep by 4m high at top of ridged roof, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
No part of the proposed outbuilding would be within 5m of any part of the house as extended or nearer to the highway than the house and taken together with the existing extensions to the house would not exceed 50% of the total area of the curtilage (excluding the ground area of the original dwellinghouse) and is for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of a dwellinghouse.  The development falls within Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

INFORMATIVE: 
The detached outbuilding for use as a gym/store hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as No. 56 Harewood Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a gym/store to the rear garden of existing house
